# Get-ZbxSetting

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the frontend's global settings.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxSetting [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxSetting cmdlet reads the global settings of Administration > General with settings.get: the default theme and language, the work period, the severity names and colors, the login lockout and the other frontend options. It writes one ZabbixSettingsRecord object and needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer. Set-ZbxSetting changes the settings.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Read the work period and the default theme

```powershell
Get-ZbxSetting | Select-Object WorkPeriod, DefaultTheme, DefaultLanguage
```

WorkPeriod is the days and hours graphs shade as working time.

### Example 2: List the severity names

```powershell
$settings = Get-ZbxSetting
0..5 | ForEach-Object { $settings."SeverityName$_" }
```

SeverityName0 to SeverityName5 are the six severities, from Not classified to Disaster.
